# Cook Tap snapshot

- Source: https://github.com/nascarjake/cooktap
- Commit: `2d853495b03f837ef86bf20a591547bc1161a88f` (master, fetched 2026-10-17).
- `cooktap-original/` contains the ten tracked files, unchanged, **128676 bytes** (excluding Git metadata).
- Local clone metadata moved to ignored `.cooktap-git/`; no nested Git repository or submodule is shipped.
- README and package.json declare MIT. No LICENSE/COPYING file or explicit copyright notice exists in this tree. This is a declaration of MIT, not an upstream full license text. Package author: Cook Tap Development Team. Repository owner: nascarjake.
- No third-party dependencies or binary assets; system Arial/sans-serif and text emojis only. No externally downloaded image/font/audio/icon is reused.
- Mobile adaptation uses simplified recipe data and the timing/score rule from `js/order-system.js`; it does not execute the original DOM/keyboard classes. Attribution and standard MIT terms are supplied in the prototype's `public/` directory, explicitly distinguished from the absent upstream license file.
